work_item: BODY-1 bounded BB-CONTENT generated-code verification consumer
execution_mode: fresh CLI process per request; temporary actor/case state
producer_consumer: structured code request -> committed source and immutable CodeGenerationReport -> ordinary generated-code verification request -> same-case report/source revalidation -> bounded native finite-case evaluator -> verification report -> content/render/local-file receipt
scope: Only a just-prior committed structured function generation in the same actor/case is consumed. The user supplies finite JSON test cases. Core reparses the stored generated source with the existing restricted Python AST reader and evaluates that AST using Rust's bounded native interpreter; it does not invoke host Python, exec, eval, a compiler, or external effects. Passing finite examples do not establish general correctness or run Python input/output tests.
